raw_action:
import pyautogui, time

# Click the To: field and enter your email
pyautogui.click(600, 224)
time.sleep(0.2)
pyautogui.write("mathias.gadenzi@gmail.com")
time.sleep(0.2)

# Click the Subject: field and enter a subject
pyautogui.click(607, 260)
time.sleep(0.2)
pyautogui.write("Action Steps: RSVP for Public PhD defense")
time.sleep(0.2)

# Click into the message body and draft the action steps
pyautogui.click(537, 596)
time.sleep(0.2)
pyautogui.write(
    "Hello Mathias,\n\n"
    "Based on Alice’s RSVP invitation, here are your next steps:\n"
    "1. Reply to Alice confirming your attendance.\n"
    "2. Ask her to send the Zoom link once available.\n"
    "3. Block time in your calendar for the defense.\n"
    "4. Prepare any questions or remarks in advance.\n\n"
    "Best,\n"
    "Mathias"
)
